record.Description: This recall involves QZH.DUAO pajama sets. The pajama sets consist of short-sleeve tops and matching pants. They were sold in Pink Bow, Pink, Black, Light Blue, Purple, Mint Green, Hot Pink, Pink Bowknot, Blue Bowknot, Pink Strawberry and Pink Bow Flower and in sizes 4-5T through 13-14 years.
record.Title: Fashion Brand Apparel Recalls QZH.DUAO Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children’s Sleepwear

Hazards.Name: The recalled children’s pajama sets violate the mandatory safety standards for children’s sleepwear, posing a risk of serious burn injuries.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled pajama sets immediately and contact Fashion Brand Apparel for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pajamas in half and email a photo of the destroyed pajama set to qzh.duaoproductrecall@outlook.com to receive the refund. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed product.

ai.summary: Fashion Brand Apparel has recalled about 300 QZH.DUAO children's pajama sets consisting of short-sleeve tops and matching pants. The sleepwear fails to comply with mandatory federal safety standards for children's sleepwear. This violation creates a dangerous burn hazard that can lead to severe injuries.
ai.next_steps: Immediately stop using the pajamas and reach out to Fashion Brand Apparel for a full refund. To qualify for the refund, cut the pajama set in half, email a photograph of the destroyed item to qzh.duaoproductrecall@outlook.com, and then discard the remnants.
